column2: Workload-specific example; application and template composition does not belong in the base-image repository.
Kubernetes-specific kernel with guest bridge/veth/CNI-oriented facilities; rejected in favor of a generic NIC-less rootless base contract.
The artifact VERSION is read from the pinned mvm Cargo.toml [workspace.package].version, so a hand-kept copy has nothing left to pin.
